test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Make in India initiative aims to boost domestic manufacturing. In which year was the 'Make in India' campaign launched?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**2014**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Make in India** initiative was launched on **25th September 2014** by the **Government of India**.
 
• This program was introduced by the **Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi**, to transform India into a global manufacturing hub.
 
• The initiative aims to encourage companies to manufacture their products in **India** and incentivize dedicated investments into the manufacturing sector.
 
• The campaign focuses on job creation, skill development, and boosting **domestic manufacturing**.
 
• It targets various sectors, including **automobiles, textiles, chemicals, IT, aviation, pharmaceuticals, and electronics**, among others.
 
• Under this initiative, the government has simplified regulations and policies to attract both **domestic and foreign investments**.
 
• The campaign introduced initiatives like **liberalization of FDI policy**, ease of doing business, and improving infrastructure.
 
• The **Make in India logo** features a lion made of cogs, representing manufacturing strength and national pride.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2012**

 
 
• This option is incorrect as the **Make in India initiative** was launched two years later, in **2014**.
 
 
 
• **2016**
 
 
• This year is incorrect as it marks two years after the official launch of the **Make in India campaign**.
 
 
 
• **2018**
 
 
• Although this year witnessed further developments under the **Make in India initiative**, the campaign was originally launched in **2014**.
